verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a first-party, versioned "Lovable API" with an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, an interactive reference, date-pinned versions and a deprecation policy. Its official MCP server lets an AI agent create projects, send build messages, inspect code and deploy apps, which covers programmatic generation and management. The docs-path OpenAPI probe 404 does not contradict this, because the spec is served from the API host. Missing for 10: explicit endpoint-level documentation of project creation and generation in the REST API (the only cited endpoint is listing workspaces), independent hands-on corroboration, and broad availability (workspace API keys require a Business or Enterprise plan).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate and manage apps programmatically through a platform API

citations.quote: your AI agent can create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code, deploy apps, and more, all without leaving the client you're already working in
Lovable serves its full OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Lovable API") from the API host itself
Executing requests needs a workspace API key, which requires a Business or Enterprise plan.
The `/v1` surface is versioned and stable.
